text:
Martin (AE): Heads up — HarborTech is asking for a bespoke rate to convert POC -> prod. They need Private deployment (VPC + KMS) + Dedicated capacity. Customer is proposing a 12mo commit (~$300k total) and asking for 35% off list. Security questionnaire still open. Can deal desk weigh in?
Tara (SE): Tech-wise this is fine. They'll need BYOK and a small network runbook. Perf validated for their 8k tokens/profile; we should reserve node pool sizing.
Josh (SRE): FWIW dedicated pool of 3 nodes min, autoscale off for isolation. POC load patterns look spiky so caching/kv config matter.
Maria (RevOps): Need the precise price schedule (monthly, prepay terms) and an explicit request for >25% discount. Anything above 25% needs finance/manager approval.
Martin (AE): Numbers draft:
```
Commit: $300,000 total (12mo)
List monthly: $25,000/mo
Requested discount: 35% -> $16,250/mo -> effective $195,000 ARR
Proposed prepay: 3mo up front
POC credit: 25% credit applied to first 90 days
```
Martin (AE): Also they're asking for extended retention (13 months) and data export rights.
Olivia (CSM): We have SOW in progress. Security: customer requires SOC2 + encryption at rest with customer-managed keys. Legal already flagged a couple of clauses.
FinanceBot: Automated check: deals >$200k require controller approval and payment terms. Please run /price-approval harbortech-2332.
Elaine (RevOps Manager): I can sign up to 30% off but only if: 1) 12mo commit, 2) 3mo prepaid, 3) SLA credit cap and rollback clause if usage <50% of commit. We also want a short pilot success metric in the SOW.
Maria (RevOps): To be explicit: Deal desk will approve 30% conditioned on Elaine's items plus legal signoff on KMS/SOC2 language. Anything above 30% needs VP revops.
Ben (Legal): I will review contract redlines. Notes: cannot accept unlimited export rights; will scope data egress. Also need to review indemnity/limitations. 48h turnaround expected.
Martin (AE): Customer initially asked 35% and longer retention. If 30% with 3mo prepay & explicit security clauses gets them to sign, I'm ok to push that.
Tara (SE): We'll prepare a runbook + BOM for the dedicated pool and attach to SOW.
Maria (RevOps): Action items: Martin to confirm they accept 30% + 3mo prepay; Martin to run /price-approval harbortech-2332 after confirmation; Ben to send redlines; Olivia to finalise SOW. Tagging @Elaine @Ben @Olivia for visibility. :pray:
Martin (AE): Thanks all — I'll update the customer and aim to close this week. Ping me if you need the /price-approval command or the commit calc.
